in_hebrew.name: Frydman
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Freedom of the mind
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Frydman הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old High German, Frid means peace or freedom. Man means human. Frydman could symbolize a person who is at peace with their thoughts and beliefs.

in_greek.name: Frydman
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Freedom of the mind
in_greek.long_meaning: Frydman είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old High German, Frid means peace or freedom. Man means human. Frydman could symbolize a person who is at peace with their thoughts and beliefs.

in_latin.name: Frydman
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Freedom of the mind
in_latin.long_meaning: Frydman est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old High German, Frid means peace or freedom. Man means human. Frydman could symbolize a person who is at peace with their thoughts and beliefs.
